titulo: Training Twice a Day? Session 2, On My Way
caption:
Training twice a day, explained by a group chat. Cella trained once today. "The favorite" texts back: "like a peasant." Cella, flat on the floor, reads it, gets up, answers "session 2. omw" and grabs her gym bag.

Is working out twice a day good or bad? It depends on you. Two-a-days usually mean splitting one workout into two shorter sessions, often one easy and one harder. For beginners, most coaches say to get consistent with one session a day first, and to back off if sleep or recovery starts to slip.

This is a cartoon about sibling rivalry, not a training plan.
